sources.title: Hold RLUSD in Binance Earn and Margin Accounts to Share 1 Million XRP in Rewards
Binance Earn Yield Arena: Earn Up to $5,888 Rewards With This Week's New Limited-Time Offers! (2026-08-26)

rlusd_xrp_campaign.balance_rule: seven-day average of each day's lowest RLUSD balance across hourly snapshots
eligible_balance_locations: RLUSD net assets in Cross Margin Isolated Margin or Portfolio Margin
rlusd_xrp_campaign.qualifying_volume_rule: at least 500 USD average daily Margin or Futures volume on any pairs while using RLUSD as collateral
account_gates: actual qualifying Margin or Futures volume
rlusd_xrp_campaign.source_consistency_note: The worked examples still use an explicitly illustrative 20 percent APR while the completed-week table reports 8.07 percent; only the completed-week table value is admitted as observed realized-period evidence.

excluded_from_break_even: custody stablecoin tax and opportunity costs
qualification_cost_sensitivity.usage_rule: This sensitivity never authorizes volume created solely to qualify. Treat qualifying volume as zero incremental cost only when it is independently genuine pre-existing activity.

adjudication.rlusd_candidate_scope: eligible account with already-held RLUSD and independently genuine pre-existing qualifying volume
reasons_not_accepted: only one completed RLUSD reward week is published
future RLUSD APR is unknown and campaign ends on 2026-09-11
account and jurisdiction eligibility are unproved
exact incremental qualification entry exit and opportunity costs are unproved
the USDT and USDC offers are temporary first-come variable-rate offers with very small bonus caps
next_evidence: observe the second and third published RLUSD effective APRs without refitting this scope
if credentials and authority become available prove account eligibility and existing organic qualifying volume without inspecting or serializing credential values
compare exact account RLUSD and USDT or USDC yields and all frictions before any funded action
prohibited_shortcuts: infer residence or account eligibility from system timezone
manufacture churn self-trades wash trades or otherwise inauthentic volume
treat the illustrative 20 percent examples as the completed-week APR
extrapolate one observed week across the remaining campaign
call a temporary capped promotion a stable persistent edge
